meta.title: Fraud Labs
meta.subtitle: Practise spotting a scam. Know what to do next.

home.heading: Pause before you pay.
home.body: Try safe examples. Learn the warning signs. Know where to get help.
home.rule: Nobody real will ask for your OTP, PIN or CVV. Never pay to receive money.
home.imageAlt: Fraud Labs collage showing scam warnings, a worried family and money
home.terms: OTP: one-time code · PIN: secret payment number · CVV: card security digits · UPI: phone-based bank payment.

checks.title: Pause
checks.text: A real emergency does not need a secret payment.

checks.title: Verify
checks.text: Call back using a number you already trust.

checks.title: Protect
checks.text: Keep your OTP, PIN, CVV and screen to yourself.

help.heading: This can happen to anyone.
help.body: Act quickly. You do not need to feel ashamed.
help.step1: Call 1930 as soon as possible. Keep the transaction details nearby.
help.step2: Report at cybercrime.gov.in. Save the acknowledgement number and message.
help.step3: Call your bank using its official app, card or website. Ask it to block exposed cards, UPI or account access.
help.step4: Keep screenshots, messages, caller numbers, links, transaction IDs and bank complaint details. Do not delete them.
help.note: Do not send more money to anyone promising to recover your money.
help.readyText: Time and amount · bank or UPI reference · caller number or link · screenshots · bank complaint number.

frauds.label: UPI collect request
frauds.title: A request to receive money
frauds.message: A caller says: “I am sending you ₹2,000. Open the payment app and enter your UPI PIN to receive it.”
frauds.why: A UPI PIN approves a payment. You do not enter it to receive money.
frauds.goal: To make you approve a payment to them.
frauds.nextStep: Decline the request. Check your balance in the app yourself.

frauds.label: Fake bank link
frauds.title: Your account will stop today
frauds.message: Message: “Your account will be blocked tonight. Open this link and update your details now.”
frauds.why: The message pushes you to open an unverified link and share details.
frauds.goal: To steal your login or card details through a fake page.
frauds.nextStep: Do not open the link. Open your bank app or type its known website address.

frauds.label: Family emergency
frauds.title: A stranger says they are family
frauds.message: Call: “I am your nephew. My phone is broken. Send money to this new number. Do not call anyone else.”
frauds.why: The caller creates panic and asks you to keep it secret. Call your family on a known number.
frauds.goal: To make you send money before you can verify who called.
frauds.nextStep: End the call. Contact your relative using a number you already know.

frauds.label: Fake KYC update
frauds.title: KYC warning
frauds.message: Message: “Your KYC expires in one hour. Send your OTP and card photo to keep your account active.”
frauds.why: A genuine service will not ask for your OTP or card photo in chat.
frauds.goal: To collect your OTP and card details.
frauds.nextStep: Do not reply. Contact the bank through its official app or website.

frauds.label: Digital arrest threat
frauds.title: A caller claims you are under arrest
frauds.message: Call: “Police case against you. Stay on video. Do not tell your family. Pay a security deposit now.”
frauds.why: A caller cannot put you under digital arrest or demand money to end a case.
frauds.goal: To frighten you into sending money or sharing private details.
frauds.nextStep: End the call. Speak to a trusted person and contact the police through official channels.

frauds.label: Fake job fee
frauds.title: Work from home offer
frauds.message: Message: “Earn ₹8,000 every day. Pay ₹499 for your joining kit before the interview.”
frauds.why: The offer promises unusually high pay and asks for money before a real job.
frauds.goal: To collect a fee without giving you a real job.
frauds.nextStep: Do not pay to get an interview. Check the employer through its official website.

frauds.label: QR to receive money
frauds.title: Scan to get your refund
frauds.message: Message: “Scan this QR and enter your UPI PIN. Your refund will arrive instantly.”
frauds.why: Scanning a payment QR and entering your PIN can send money out.
frauds.goal: To make you approve money going out of your account.
frauds.nextStep: Do not scan it. Ask for a normal payment confirmation instead.

frauds.label: Instant loan app
frauds.title: Loan approved
frauds.message: Message: “Your loan is approved. Pay a release fee now. Install this app from the file we sent.”
frauds.why: An unknown app and an advance fee are warning signs. Check a lender before sharing details.
frauds.goal: To collect an advance fee or install an unsafe app.
frauds.nextStep: Do not install the file. Check the lender and app through official sources.

frauds.label: Prize or lottery
frauds.title: You have won a prize
frauds.message: Message: “You won ₹5 lakh. Pay ₹2,500 tax to this personal account to claim it today.”
frauds.why: A prize message asks for money before you receive anything.
frauds.goal: To collect a fee for a prize that may not exist.
frauds.nextStep: Do not pay. Check whether you entered the contest through its official organiser.

frauds.label: Fake customer care
frauds.title: A stranger offers a refund
frauds.message: Call: “I am customer care. Install this screen-sharing app and tell me the code so I can refund you.”
frauds.why: Screen sharing can expose private information and let a stranger control your phone.
frauds.goal: To see your screen, read private details or control your phone.
frauds.nextStep: Close the call. Find customer care in the official app or on your bank card.

frauds.label: Investment group
frauds.title: Guaranteed daily returns
frauds.message: Group message: “Put in ₹10,000. Get guaranteed 5% profit every day. Add two friends to unlock the next level.”
frauds.why: No real investment can promise guaranteed daily profit. Pressure to recruit others is another warning.
frauds.goal: To take your deposit and persuade you to bring in others.
frauds.nextStep: Do not transfer money. Check the firm and product with the relevant regulator.
